dedupe_keys.name: building level heat demand time series derived from open data case study dataset

description: Building-Level Heat Demand Time Series Derived from Open Data is a dataset deposited by Simon Malacek at Graz University of Technology. It contains building-level attributes and hourly heating-demand profiles for two Spanish study areas. The Puertollano case-study CSV provides simulated heat demand for many buildings, with 8,760 hourly values per building. A second CSV contains validation data for a selected quarter in Madrid. The repository lists the dataset as open and provides two CSV files: a 485.5 MB case-study file and a 25.2 kB validation file. DataCite records the dataset under DOI 10.3217/64x6f-j9779 and assigns Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0. Access is free through the repository record and DOI, with no registration stated. Caveats: the public version removes house numbers, building shapes and centroids; calendar years for the simulated profiles are not stated. The data can support heat-demand simulation, model calibration and validation, and building or heat-network capacity planning. No related catalogue record was confirmed.
